sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (its move loop): a stalking stride on the stilt legs, hunched forward, the scythe held upright behind it with the blade over its head, the claw arm swinging, the LEGS CHANGING OVER as written for each frame
sheets.weapons: THE SCYTHE goes where the pale figure has it, frame by frame (image 3 shows it in colour): the long black wooden shaft and the rusty red-brown curved blade, as long as in image 1, in its burlap-wrapped hand - upright behind it, swung back, held out level, raised overhead or swept down, as the pale figure has it. Its thin black wooden claw arm and its claws where the pale figure has them. Only it: no crows, no smoke, no dark bolts, no glow; the eyes' light stays inside the eyes.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the NEAR leg (the lighter one) straight down under its hips, its hooked claw foot flat on the ground line; the FAR leg (the darker one) bent and kicked back behind it, its foot off the ground. Frame 2: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the near leg still planted under its hips, bending; the far leg swinging down from behind, its foot low, just off the ground behind the planted one. The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-4 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) carries it and the FAR leg comes forward, in frames 5-8 the FAR leg (the darker one) carries it and the NEAR leg comes forward - frames 1 and 5 must show a different leg planted. Draw the legs AS WRITTEN for each frame, not the pale figure's (the old 1x legs are too small to read; runs drawn after them kept the same legs in all 8 frames: 「走路没有换腿」). The body, the sack head, the saw disc, the arms and the scythe follow the pale figure. The scythe's shaft reaches down to the ground but is NOT a leg: its two thin stilt legs carry it.
